harness.cwdClass: Dedicated non-/tmp source checkout with its own dependencies, identical frozen source. This is not a claim that known checkout-location fixture failures are fixed.
harness.offline: Existing preload and explicit ordinary-UID user/network namespace with loopback only and no external routes; capabilities dropped before the timed original command.
harness.timing: GNU time inside shared benchmark lock; uncontrolled shared-host load.
harness.authority: Existing governed maintenance worker authority, native handles, bindings, argv/environment and data/event oracles unchanged. The existing stderr pipe carries one finite numeric record after each loop; stdout stays byte-for-byte original. No new inherited FD or write permission.
harness.observation: Synchronous timestamps bracket each original awaited Bun.sleep. The parent attaches a logging continuation to the original stderr.text() promise and returns that same promise. The complete original stderr string remains available to its error-context assertion or Promise.all result. No second stream reader or new await/timer/global. Child stderr IO and host console/continuation overhead are explicit.

identity.normalization: Remove only observeGateStderr wrapper around original new Response(...).text() expressions; same original promise is returned.

limits: The observations cover only these three selected existing callers. Each predicate sampler finishes on its existing release condition; the measured duration is not a required elapsed floor.
